english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for a machine, system, or organization functioning or operating.
Use this as the all-purpose verb for a machine or system working.
Use this when a system, process, organization, or mechanism functions or operates by itself.
Use 運作 when something functions or operates in a particular way.
